newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet prices ease slightly in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet prices ease slightly in thin trade.

text.p: U.S. jet fuel prices ended modestly weaker Wednesday as both differentials and the NYMEX basis price slipped.
On the NYMEX, June heating oil futures dipped 0.06 cent by the settlement, paring the sharp selloff from earlier in the day.
U.S. Gulf 54-grade jet fuel for prompt delivery was talked between 1.00 and 1.25 cents under the NYMEX, down about 0.25 cent on the day.
New York Harbor prompt 54-grade barrels were talked between 1.40 and 1.65 cents over the June futures, off about 0.10 cent.
The American Petroleum Institute report released Tuesday evening showed a build of about 1.1 million barrels in jet fuel stocks for the latest week.
